answer: Freshness is enforced, not assumed. A lantern must be lit against tonight's wind: every credential renews only against a hash of a live block, so clones sitting crystal-still on a snapshot mined months ago decay to zero weight. A verifier demands a solution over the current chain head, and head-attestations expire fast — nobody can voyage offline and arrive credentialed. Cost to a sybil: one real, continuously running node per ghost, epoch after epoch.
